From f2b70418ec6f104981b54709a4cfe3a3c46b7d8f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2021 12:59:50 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] soc: fsl: Correct MAINTAINERS database (QUICC ENGINE LIBRARY)

MAINTAINERS lacks of proper coverage for FSL headers. Fix it accordingly.

Fixes: 7aa1aa6ecec2 ("QE: Move QE from arch/powerpc to drivers/soc")
Signed-off-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Li Yang <leoyang.li@nxp.com>

diff --git a/MAINTAINERS b/MAINTAINERS
index ea3e6c914384..9abac76757ad 100644
--- a/MAINTAINERS
+++ b/MAINTAINERS
@@ -7736,8 +7736,7 @@ M:	Qiang Zhao <qiang.zhao@nxp.com>
 L:	linuxppc-dev@lists.ozlabs.org
 S:	Maintained
 F:	drivers/soc/fsl/qe/
-F:	include/soc/fsl/*qe*.h
-F:	include/soc/fsl/*ucc*.h
+F:	include/soc/fsl/qe/
 
 FREESCALE QUICC ENGINE UCC ETHERNET DRIVER
 M:	Li Yang <leoyang.li@nxp.com>
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **MAINTAINERS**
   - The entries for the Freescale QUICC Engine Library have been modified to improve coverage of the relevant headers.
   - The following lines were removed:
     - `F:	include/soc/fsl/*qe*.h`
     - `F:	include/soc/fsl/*ucc*.h`
   - A new line was added:
     - `F:	include/soc/fsl/qe/`

### Relationships
- The changes in the MAINTAINERS file are aimed at correcting the coverage of the Freescale QUICC Engine Library headers, ensuring that the relevant files are properly listed for maintenance. This modification is directly related to the previous commit identified by the fix tag, which indicates that the restructuring of the QUICC Engine from the architecture directory to the drivers directory necessitated an update in the MAINTAINERS file to reflect the new file organization.

soc: fsl: Correct MAINTAINERS database (QUICC ENGINE LIBRARY)

MAINTAINERS lacks of proper coverage for FSL headers. Fix it accordingly.

Fixes: 7aa1aa6ecec2 ("QE: Move QE from arch/powerpc to drivers/soc")
Signed-off-by: Andy Shevchenko <andriy.shevchenko@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Li Yang <leoyang.li@nxp.com>

Here is the root cause:
The MAINTAINERS file lacked proper coverage for the Freescale QUICC Engine Library headers, which could lead to confusion regarding the maintenance responsibilities and oversight of the relevant files after the relocation of the QUICC Engine from the architecture directory to the drivers directory. This oversight could result in untracked changes or issues in the library due to the absence of proper entries in the MAINTAINERS file.

-F:	include/soc/fsl/*qe*.h
-F:	include/soc/fsl/*ucc*.h
+F:	include/soc/fsl/qe/
